2. Extreme internal jargon (PREM, TTC, FoVer, CCTU, SVAMP) that means nothing to an outsider.

- Hero / Stats bar — `FoVer math step-errors (5-seed)` — A stranger has no idea what FoVer is.

- The Hero boasts a `0.9131` AUROC for "FoVer". The Results grid highlights a `0.90` AUC for "EstimationVerifier SVAMP" and `0.91` AUROC for "prompt-injection classifier". Throwing three different ~0.91 metrics for completely different domains makes them all blur together and feel arbitrary.

- Results Grid — `k=5 ensemble catches 60/60 attacks` — Perfect 100% defense against adversarial attacks triggers immediate skepticism.
